items.description: Identification as a randomised trial in the title
Structured summary of trial design, methods, results, and conclusions, with a focus on harms
Scientific background and explanation of rationale, including the importance of harms
Specific objectives or hypotheses related to harms
Completely defined pre-specified primary and secondary harm outcomes, including how and when they were assessed
Any changes to harm outcomes after the trial commenced, with reasons
How harms were defined, assessed, and collected
For each group, the number of participants who experienced each harm and the number of harms
Interpretation consistent with results, balancing benefits and harms, and considering other relevant evidence
